import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

class LegacyModel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.coef_ = None
        self.woe_tables = {}

    def fit(self, frame: pd.DataFrame, train_rows: np.ndarray | None = None) -> "LegacyModel":
        # Filter the data based on train_rows
        if train_rows is not None:
            frame = frame[frame[".row"].isin(train_rows)]

        # QUIRK: R's factor() creates dummy variables with the first level dropped
        frame["veh_age"] = frame["veh_age"].astype("category")
        frame["agecat"] = frame["agecat"].astype("category")

        # Fit the model
        X = pd.get_dummies(frame["veh_body"], prefix="veh_body", drop_first=True)
        X["veh_age"] = frame["veh_age"].cat.codes
        X["agecat"] = frame["agecat"].cat.codes
        area_dummies = pd.get_dummies(frame["area"], prefix="area", drop_first=True)
        for col in area_dummies.columns:
            X[col] = area_dummies[col]
        X["gender"] = pd.get_dummies(frame["gender"], prefix="gender", drop_first=True)
        X = sm.add_constant(X, has_constant="add")
        y = frame["numclaims"]
        exposure = frame["exposure"]

        # Fit GLM with log link and offset
        self.model = sm.GLM(y, X, family=sm.families.Poisson(link=sm.families.links.log()), offset=np.log(exposure)).fit(tol=1e-12, maxiter=100)
        self.coef_ = pd.Series(self.model.params)

        return self

    def score(self, frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # Prepare the same feature set as in fit
        X = pd.get_dummies(frame["veh_body"], prefix="veh_body", drop_first=True)
        X["veh_age"] = frame["veh_age"].astype("category").cat.codes
        X["agecat"] = frame["agecat"].astype("category").cat.codes
        area_dummies = pd.get_dummies(frame["area"], prefix="area", drop_first=True)
        for col in area_dummies.columns:
            X[col] = area_dummies[col]
        X["gender"] = pd.get_dummies(frame["gender"], prefix="gender", drop_first=True)
        X = sm.add_constant(X, has_constant="add")

        # Predict using the fitted model
        eta = self.model.predict(X)
        freq_hat = np.exp(eta)  # Since we are using a log link

        # Prepare the output DataFrame
        output = pd.DataFrame(index=frame.index)
        output["score"] = freq_hat / frame["exposure"]  # per unit exposure

        return output

    @property
    def coef(self) -> pd.Series | None:
        return self.coef_
